scope: Every full-size output pixel is finite, changes are contained in declared paint, alpha and immutable source/recipe/sensor hashes remain exact, and every exported Display P3 RGBA16 component/profile is decoded and checked on one real owned GFX photo.

receipt.scope: Full saved painted-layer render and every RGBA16 TIFF sample/profile check on one owned source; numerical export conformance, not physical display colorimetry

memory_scope: Peak of a verifier that holds base and rendered float rasters concurrently for all-pixel comparison; not ordinary editor/export RSS or complete GB10 memory.
timing_scope: Initial RAW decode and full joint preparation precede render timers. Total probe time includes them, hashes, conformance scan, encoding and all-strip decode verification. Shared machine, single observation, no universal latency claim.
limits: This verifies execution, exact target containment and encoded color/alpha conformance, not every camera/physical monitor or universal synthesis quality.
The export decoder is the TIFF crate; independent system LibTIFF large-offset verification has separate evidence in the existing large-TIFF record.
